text:
Jordan Lee: Opening PR #512 — adds section on audit export anonymization, retention tiers, and a Go SDK example. Need legal + privacy review for SOC2 phrasing and allowed guarantees.

Priya Nair: Quick note: current draft says 'we redact all PII on export' which is too absolute. Grace, can you suggest safer wording?

Grace (privacy): Prefer: 'Redaction is available for common PII fields (email, phone, ip). Customers may request additional field redaction; scope subject to feasibility and contract.' Also add that exports are encrypted in transit and at rest and note KMS options.

Ben Torres: I added a table of retention tiers (30d / 90d / 365d / contract) and a CLI example showing `--retention-days`. Draft CLI below.

```bash
redwoodctl audit export create \
  --from 2025-02-01T00:00:00Z --to 2025-03-01T00:00:00Z \
  --retention-days 365 --legal-hold=false --redact email,ip \
  --output-format json
```

Jordan Lee: Nice. Legal asks we include the request path for extended retention and that we don't promise retention beyond contract. Grace — can we include sample email wording customers should use to request extension?

Grace (privacy): Yes: `To request extended retention, please contact support@redwood.com with subject 'Retention request: <org>' and include business justification and desired TTL. Requests for >1 year require a contractual amendment.` Add link to /docs/soc2-controls.

Priya Nair: Also adding a short Go SDK snippet to match other SDKs. Ben — can you sanity-check?

Ben Torres: Go snippet draft:```go
package main
import (
  "fmt"
  "github.com/redwood/clientsdk"
)
func main(){
  c := clientsdk.New("$REDWOOD_KEY")
  id, err := c.Audit().CreateExport(map[string]interface{}{
    "from": "2025-02-01T00:00:00Z",
    "to": "2025-03-01T00:00:00Z",
    "retention_ttl_days": 365,
    "legal_hold": false,
    "redact_fields": []string{"email","ip"},
  })
  if err!=nil{fmt.Println("err",err);return}
  fmt.Println("export id:",id)
}
```

Grace (privacy): Go snippet looks good; minor language tweak to explain `legal_hold` semantics: `legal_hold=true prevents automated deletion for the export object; it does not alter underlying tenant retention without contract.`

Priya Nair: I'll add that sentence. Also legal asked we mention KMS rotation note: "If customer-managed keys are used, key rotation may affect the ability to decrypt older exports; coordinate rotations with Redwood support."

link-checker-bot: :robot_face: automated check: external link /docs/soc2-controls resolves on main but staging shows 502. Recommend adding a footnote: "staging link may be intermittent" and file RET-2234 to track stability.

Jordan Lee: Added footnote and RET ticket. One more ask — can we include a short SQL filter example for export scoping? e.g., show filtering by actor or event type.

Ben Torres: Added a simple filter example: `WHERE event_type='login' AND actor_email LIKE '%@example.com'`. Also included note that exports respect RBAC — customers should ensure API keys have export scope.

Grace (privacy): Approve from privacy with edits. Legal signoff pending small contract phrasing tweak (no implied SLA for export turnaround times).

Priya Nair: I'll update PR with Grace's edits, add the email template, Go + CLI samples, SQL filter, KMS note, and the footnote for staging link flakiness.

Jordan Lee: Thanks — once CI & link checks pass, please merge. Filing follow-ups: RET-2234 (staging link), RET-2235 (add Go SDK examples parity across guides).

link-checker-bot: :white_check_mark: local link-check passed for docs branch (staging still shows intermittent failures).
